about: Attorney Marc Ginsberg is a partner with Mandina Ginsberg PLLC law firm in Miami Lakes, Florida. A nationally ranked trial lawyer with nearly 40 years of total legal experience, Mr. Ginsberg focuses his practice solely on complex civil litigation arising from catastrophic injuries and wrongful death claims, and he provides unmatched advocacy and support to clients throughout Miami-Dade and Broward counties who are suffering needlessly due to the negligence or wrongdoing of others. The vast majority of cases come from referring / participating attorneys. Mr. Ginsberg appreciates and welcomes these referrals and the opportunity to co-counsel.

Board-certified in Civil Trial Law by The Florida Bar's Board of Legal Specialization, Mr. Ginsberg has achieved remarkable success fighting for the rights and entitlements of individuals and families adversely affected by medical malpractice, motor vehicle accidents, defective products, watercraft accidents, construction accidents, unsafe property conditions and other preventable tragedies. From his efforts, he has recovered millions of dollars in total compensation for his plaintiff clients, including numerous multimillion-dollar verdicts and settlements.

In honor of his outstanding professionalism and superior client service, Mr. Ginsberg has earned an AV Preeminent peer review rating* from Martindale-Hubbell along with many other top rankings and endorsements from his peers. He has also received scores of testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients, and he finds great reward in being able to help so many in his area obtain the justice they deserve for their pain and suffering.

An honors graduate of the University of Florida, Mr. Ginsberg returned to his alma mater and obtained his Juris Doctor from the University of Florida's Levin College of Law in 1981. The Florida Bar admitted him to practice that same year, and he is also admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court Southern and Middle Districts of Florida and the Northern District of Georgia as well as before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit, the Florida appellate courts and Florida Supreme Court.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
